title: Proactive Learning Integration
description: Auto-trigger learning when agents encounter new patterns, novel scenarios, conflicting knowledge, or confidence drops. Builds on TK-MS8 reinforcement learning foundation.

units.title: Proactive Learning Triggers
units.description: Detect learning opportunities: new patterns in shop data, novel manufacturing scenarios, conflicting knowledge atoms, confidence drops in existing knowledge.

units.title: Learning Trigger Classification
units.description: Classify and prioritize learning triggers for action. Route to appropriate learning handlers.

units.title: Knowledge Quality Monitoring
units.description: Continuous monitoring of knowledge quality across tribal tips, atoms, and inferred facts.

units.title: Auto-Categorization Improvements
units.description: Improve auto-categorization with feedback from learning triggers and quality monitoring.

summary.ai_integration: Full proactive learning integration enabling AI to auto-detect learning opportunities, classify triggers by priority, monitor knowledge quality, and improve categorization through feedback loops
